name: Filled Containment Coffer
summary: In the Undercity, Forsaken spellcasters use Filled Containment Coffers to capture erratic magical entities. A Cantation of Manifestation reveals and weakens rift spawn in the Apothecarium, so mages can seal them inside for examination.

sections.title: Trapping the Unseen
sections.body: Magical disturbances have appeared in Algernon's shop in the Apothecarium. The Forsaken mage Anastasia Hartwell has called on arcane practitioners to capture the entities behind them. Rift creatures are living magical energy and cannot be seen, so ordinary cages cannot hold them. Spellcasters reveal them with a Cantation of Manifestation, defeat them in combat, and snap prepared coffers shut around them. The sealed boxes protect their carriers from volatile magical backlashes and keep the creatures intact for magical dissection.

sections.title: Arcane Forensics
sections.body: Living mana creatures in the Undercity pose a serious threat. Once sealed inside containment coffers, the beasts are carried to Anastasia Hartwell and the city's scholars. Forsaken mages seek to learn whether the intrusions come from natural rifts in Azeroth's magical fabric or are preliminary probes in a calculated magical assault on the kingdom.

faq.q: What is inside a Filled Containment Coffer?
faq.answer: Each coffer holds a captured rift spawn, an invisible creature of raw magical energy that appeared inside Algernon's alchemy shop in the Apothecarium.

faq.q: How is a containment coffer filled?
aliases: how do i capture the rift spawn
faq.answer: A mage reads the Cantation of Manifestation to reveal the hidden creatures, defeats them in combat, then uses an empty coffer to trap the remaining energy before it dissipates.

faq.q: Who wants these filled coffers in Undercity?
faq.answer: Anastasia Hartwell, a prominent mage trainer in the Undercity's Magic Quarter, asks for the sealed coffers to investigate the disturbance threatening the city.

faq.q: Why are the Forsaken studying these creatures?
faq.answer: Undercity's scholars need to learn whether the anomaly came from a random tear in the local flow of magic or a deliberate, coordinated attack by a hostile magical force.

angles.text: As a Forsaken apprentice, you handle containment coffers as a practical lesson in abjuration. You learn to reveal hidden magical entities and bind unstable arcane energy into physical wards.
As an Undead, you know the Apothecarium's safety matters greatly to the Forsaken. Investigating and containing a mysterious magical breach is an urgent concern at home.
